scripts.check: bun run typecheck && fallow audit --only dead-code --format compact --quiet && bun run duplication
scripts.ci: bun run --sequential actions:check contracts:check quality dead-code duplication architecture i18n typecheck health build
scripts.contracts:check: bun run contracts:generate && ! git status --porcelain -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/generated packages/sdk/src/generated | grep .
scripts.contracts:generate: bun run --cwd apps/api openapi:generate && bun x orval --config orval.config.ts --fail-on-warnings
scripts.cov:record: supercov -- sh -c 'SUPERCOV_TEST_KIND=unit bun run test --force -- --timeout 60000 && SUPERCOV_TEST_KIND=integration TALQO_TEST_TIMEOUT=60000 bun run test:integration' && supercov runs latest report --format istanbul --output .cache/coverage/coverage-final.json --force
scripts.health: bun run cov:record && bun run health:check
scripts.test:mutation: bun x --bun stryker run --ignoreStatic && bun x --bun stryker run stryker.dom.config.json --ignoreStatic
scripts.test:mutation:full: bun x --bun stryker run --ignoreStatic --force && bun x --bun stryker run stryker.dom.config.json --ignoreStatic --force
scripts.test:mutation:integration: bash scripts/test-integration.sh bun x --bun stryker run stryker.integration.config.json --ignoreStatic
scripts.test:mutation:integration:full: bash scripts/test-integration.sh bun x --bun stryker run stryker.integration.config.json --ignoreStatic --force
